title: 格温·拼布小心愿
description: 蓝色双卷发格温穿完整蕾边裙装，缝一块心形补丁，巨大剪刀安全收合陈列。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Gwen is an adult doll-inspired woman with bright blue curled twin ponytails, one button-like decorative eye detail, soft facial features, and a blue-black frilled dress silhouette. Keep her tailored bodice modest and fully opaque with long sleeves or a blouse beneath, opaque stockings, and shoes. Her enormous ornate scissors are closed and secured on a separate low work stand.
art_direction.scene: She sits at a sewing table and places a heart-shaped fabric patch onto a small cushion, holding a simple needle carefully above the cloth. A few large colored buttons and one thread spool are neatly arranged nearby. Her oversized closed scissors stay untouched, and the background is a pale curtain with generous paper space.
art_direction.palette: powder blue, deep teal, ivory lace, rose pink
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
